NotEnoughTranslator (NET) is a BepInEx 5 translation plugin for CRC3D3. The NET plugin does not provide translated text; please find and add it yourself.

Please see the NET-README.md file for detailed instructions. If you can't open it, search for "Markdown Online Preview" in your browser and upload it, or open it in Notepad and copy the contents.

such as https://markdownviewer.pages.dev/

Of course, the easiest way is to visit the repository below to view the online version directly.

If you cannot open GitHub, search your browser for a GitHub mirror or accelerator.

Repository: https://github.com/MeidoPromotionAssociation/CRC3D3.NotEnoughTranslator.Plugin

Online Documentation: https://github.com/MeidoPromotionAssociation/CRC3D3.NotEnoughTranslator.Plugin/tree/main/Document

Get updates or report issues: https://github.com/MeidoPromotionAssociation/CRC3D3.NotEnoughTranslator.Plugin

The local documentation is located in the following path: "CRC3D3\BepInEx\NotEnoughTranslator\Document文档"



NotEnoughTranslator 是一个 CRC3D3 翻译插件，简称 NET，NET 插件并不提供翻译文本，请自行寻找并添加。

详细说明请查看 NET-README.md，如果打不开，请浏览器搜索“markdown在线预览”，上传或把用记事本打开并把内容复制进去。

例如 https://markdownviewer.pages.dev/

当然最简单的方法是访问下面的仓库地址，直接查看在线版本。

如果您打不开 github，请浏览器搜索 github 加速。


仓库地址：https://github.com/MeidoPromotionAssociation/CRC3D3.NotEnoughTranslator.Plugin

在线文档：https://github.com/MeidoPromotionAssociation/CRC3D3.NotEnoughTranslator.Plugin/tree/main/Document

获取更新或报告问题：https://github.com/MeidoPromotionAssociation/CRC3D3.NotEnoughTranslator.Plugin

本地文档位于以下路径："CRC3D3\BepInEx\NotEnoughTranslator\Document文档"
